routines.semantics: Read or set all five N0067 actions. IGNORE and REPORT retain diagnostic semantics. Scientific entry points requiring dependable error detection reject calls before the toolkit can leave outputs undefined.

scenarios.observes: Read the original error action, select RETURN, verify full and byte-truncated output, then restore RETURN.
Read the original error action, select IGNORE, verify full and byte-truncated output, then restore RETURN.
Read the original error action, select REPORT, verify full and byte-truncated output, then restore RETURN.
Read the original error action, select ABORT, verify full and byte-truncated output, then restore RETURN.
Read the original error action, select DEFAULT, verify full and byte-truncated output, then restore RETURN.

routines.edgeAssessment: Reads report the toolkit action at the full and two-byte capacities, with an isolated runtime per choice.
routines.errorAssessment: The public boundary test checks scientific rejection under IGNORE and REPORT, invalid output capacity, diagnostic availability and recovery after RETURN.
routines.fixtureRationale: No kernels required. The reference invokes erract_c from the independent locked wheel.
routines.cleanup: Every registered case restores RETURN and runs in a dedicated process. The supplemental test uses finally to restore RETURN and release owned handles.
routines.tolerance: Exact diagnostic text and behavior; no floating-point tolerance.

node.trace: Raw error action delegates to the shared C erract shim, which calls erract_c.
